data.name: Cooler Stims
data.teaser: Five custom stims, each built for a different way to play — entry fragging, sustained healing, tanking, looting, limb repair. Now with their own models, icons, and in-hands skins. Everything configurable.
data.description:
Description

Five custom stims, each built around a different way to play. These stims add variety to the game where years of the same stims became stale.

Every stim has its own model, icon, and injector skin — in the stash, on the ground, and in your hands when you use it.

The Stims

  • APEX — the entry fragger. Big stamina pool, faster regen, and Stress Resistance for when bullets are flying. Health skill up while it runs, and Vitality levels for survivability. Energy crash and tunnel vision hit at 95 seconds, so don’t pop it early.
  • AEGIS — 9.5 health rate for a minute, and it stops all bleeds for 90 seconds. Pop it as a last resort or in a dire emergency. You pay for it with a hydration and stamina dip after.
  • IRON — the pack mule. +30 max stamina, faster regen, and a weight limit bump so you can actually haul ass out of raid, or make a quick escape. Small health and energy drain at the end.
  • ARGUS — the loot goblin special. Attention, perception and search all up for three and a half minutes. Tunnel vision and a hydration dip when it wears off.
  • GRAFT — a 5-charge trauma auto-injector. Fixes blacked and fractured limbs like a CMS. Light health regen while it works, then hands tremor and an energy dip.

Getting them

Therapist sells APEX and AEGIS at higher loyalty levels, they’re on the flea, and they spawn as loose loot and in medical containers.

Numbers not to your taste? config.json has every buff value, duration, price, and loyalty level.

Install Instructions
  1. Extract the archive
  2. Drop BOTH the BepInEx and SPT folders into your SPT root directory (1.4.0 adds a client plugin — the mod needs both halves)
  3. Buy from Therapist, hit the flea, or find them in raid
Known Limitations / Bugs
  • None currently known. If you find one, please report it (see Support tab).
Support

Found a bug or have a question? Leave a comment on this mod’s page, or reach out in my thread on the SPT Discord: https://discord.com/channels/875684761291599922/1521972310595338260

versions.description:
**Requires SPT 4.1.2 or newer.** It will not load on 4.1.1

### Added
- APEX now raises the Vitality skill for its 110 second window, on top of everything
  it already did. Less chance of bleeding out when you get hit mid-push. Tunable in
  `config.json` like the rest of the buffs

### Fixed
- GRAFT can now go in the Injector case.

**Requires SPT 4.1.1 or newer.** Not 4.1.0 — that release shipped a client bug that stopped mod bundles loading, so the stims would show a placeholder model with a stuck loading icon. SPT fixed it in 4.1.1. Still on 4.0? Stay on 1.4.0.

### Changed
- Rebuilt for SPT 4.1: .NET 10, the new mod API, and the deobfuscated client assemblies
- Dropped `package.json`

### Install
Extract into your SPT root folder. It contains `BepInEx` and `SPT_Runtime` folders.

## Added
- Custom models and icons for all five stims — no more reused vanilla donor looks
- APEX — red/orange with circuit accents
- AEGIS — white/green with heartbeat motif
- IRON — gunmetal with heat-tinted cap
- ARGUS — violet/yellow with radar plate
- GRAFT — clinical white/red with dose windows
- Stash icons, inspect view, and in-world models all use the new skins
- New client plugin (`CoolerStimsClient.dll`) — the custom skins now also show on the injector in your hands during the use animation
- Fixes stims previously showing random vanilla stim skins when used
- New F12 toggle to turn the in-hands skins on/off

## Install
- Extract the ENTIRE zip into your SPT root folder — both the `BepInEx` and `SPT` folders (1.4.0 adds a client half)
- Upgrading from 1.3.0 is safe in place, nothing needs deleting

## Changes
- Added ARGUS Perception Stim: sharpens attention, perception, and search speed for looting/salvage, with an energy boost and a tunnel-vision comedown
- Added GRAFT Trauma Injector: a multi-dose auto-injector that restores destroyed/fractured limbs (like CMS/Surv12) while also granting HealthRate, EnergyRate, and HandsTremor buffs
- GRAFT: 5 charges, treats one destroyed limb per use
- Both added to loot tables and loose loot

- AEGIS healing rate increased from 2.5 to 9.5 HP/sec
- APEX trader price updated to 84,379 roubles
- AEGIS trader price updated to 105,836 roubles
- IRON flea price updated to 179,975 roubles
- Added config.json for user-customizable buff values, durations, trader prices, and loyalty levels

- Adjusted handbook prices to balance flea market offer prices (APEX: 42,000 | AEGIS: 50,000 | IRON: 55,000)
 
^ These prices won't reflect on the Flea market and will be higher, there's a multiplier system through Ragfair based on the Handboook price, But they were wayyy too high before for my taste, especially IRON stim. 

- Updated Therapist prices to match new handbook values
- Changed APEX and AEGIS to Therapist Loyalty Level 4

## v1.1.0 Changes
- **Fixed flea market** — Stims can now be purchased from the flea market without errors
- **Fixed loot spawns** — Custom stims now properly spawn in Medcases, Medbag SMU06, and Medical supply crates across all maps
- **Fixed loose loot** — Stims now share spawn points with vanilla stims at every stim spawn location
- **Balanced spawn rates** — Loot weights tuned

-Added 3 New Stims

-APEX Combat Stim
-AEGIS Medical Stim
-IRON Endurance Stim
